text: Chapter 7: Upheaval in Ultimea@Head for Ultimea Palace
Go to the palace in Ultimea to defeat Venena the Empress of\nLyark who is afflicting people and destroyed the partisans!
Drive out the Lyark soldiers and Demi Machinas\nin the palace and find Venena the Empress!
Cooperate with Balft and Pelulu, and beat Ornlarf the leader\nof the Black Knights on the corridor in front of the throne!
[[N]]Talk to Balft in front of the general store.
